title: KHR_node_visibility_hint glTF Node Extension
description: Associates a node with a per-view visibility role. Effective hint visibility is the logical AND of the node's own hint and all ancestor hints. Evaluating the predicate does not alter glTF-authored or animated node state; the implementation technique is not prescribed.

role.description: Nonempty visibility role. The exact standard values are 'always', 'first_person', and 'third_person'; any other value is a custom role, and the specification recommends that a consumer not render content restricted by a role it does not support. The individual role predicate is true for 'always' in every render view, for 'first_person' only in views tagged 'first_person', and for 'third_person' only in views tagged 'third_person'. Ancestor node hints and KHR_node_visibility can further restrict visibility; 'always' cannot cancel an ancestor's restriction.

label.description: Nonempty human-readable label, preferred over node.name and role whenever a host or tool presents the hint to a user. It has no effect on visibility.
